jsonld_raw.name: (150 G) FLORAL BEYOND SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Floral Beyond | Emerging from the delicate essence of cherry blossom, shaped by the intoxicating aroma of peony and rose petals, and a delicious undertone of raspberry and white musk. 

Notes:
Top: bergamot, raspberry, peony.
Heart: rose, cherry blossom, heliotrope.
Base: amber, musk.
